description: One row is one reading. An empty cell is unobserved and is never stored as zero. kind is fact or inference. proxy_for is null when the reading is the thing itself.

fields.observed_at: ISO-8601 timestamp, or a date when the source has no clock time. Do not invent a clock time.
fields.timezone: Asia/Jerusalem for collection stamps. City-local fields are separate.
fields.period: Source period when the reading describes a month or quarter rather than an instant.
fields.city: Panel city. Route-basket spelling is preserved.
fields.product: UberX, Comfort, XL, Green, Reserve, or the Lyft equivalent. Blank if the reading is not a product quote.
fields.value: Number, or JSON null when unobserved. Null is not zero.
fields.proxy_for: Null, or the concept this reading must not be mistaken for (aov, trips, orders, active_users).
fields.source_url: Public page or filing. Blank only when no public URL exists, with the reason in notes.
fields.competitor: uber or lyft for a ride quote. DoorDash, Glovo, or Deliveroo only when a merchant reading names that competitor.
fields.local_weekday: City-local weekday of a repeated quote. Blank until a quote exists.
fields.local_hour: City-local hour of a repeated quote. Blank until a quote exists.

series_files.route_basket.csv: Definition of fixed Drive routes. Not a price reading.
series_files.nyc_hvfhv_monthly.csv: Fact. NYC TLC high-volume FHV daily averages by month, Uber (HV0003) and Lyft (HV0005), via the TLC Help aggregation cited in the file.
series_files.lax_tnc_monthly.csv: Fact. LAWA monthly TNC trips at LAX. Not Uber-only and not citywide trips.
series_files.driver_signup_bonuses.csv: Fact. Public US driver-guarantee ads. Not driver counts and not trip counts.
series_files.sec_q3_2026.csv: Fact. Exhibit 99.1 metrics for Q3 2025 and Q3 2026.
series_files.sec_q4_2026_guide.json: Fact. Company Q4 2026 Gross Bookings outlook from the same exhibit. Not consensus.
series_files.drive_quotes.csv: Quoted price, ETA, surge, product, and no-cars. Header only until a public or authenticated pass records a row.
series_files.eats_customer.csv: Delivery fee, ETA, minimum, promos, restaurant count at a fixed address. Header only.
series_files.eats_basket.csv: Fixed dishes plus delivery, suggested tip, and service fees. A basket proxy, not AOV. Header only.
series_files.eats_merchant.csv: Restaurant, convenience, and grocery counts, chain entries, courier ads. Header only.

null_rules.basket_index: Sum item prices, delivery, suggested tip, and service fees only when every component in that city-time is non-null. Otherwise the index is null. Never fill a missing fee with zero.
null_rules.promo_share: Restaurants showing a promo divided by restaurants observed at that address, only when both counts are non-null.
null_rules.consensus_score: hot if a panel proxy is more than 2 percentage points above an observed consensus, in-line within 2, cold more than 2 below. If the panel or the consensus is null, the score is unscored. The official SEC print is not a substitute for either input.
null_rules.tightness: Not ranked from price alone. A high quote can be strong demand or thin driver supply. Ranking waits for price, ETA, and no-cars on the same route and a prior period.

cadence.dst_note: GitHub cron is pinned to UTC+2. During Israel summer time (UTC+3) the same jobs run one hour earlier on the Jerusalem clock. This is a poll, not a tick.
cadence.quote_collection: In-app Uber, Lyft, and Eats quotes are not collected without an authenticated session. The job records the skip. It does not scrape behind login.
